welcomeDesc: Play local videos and music or from the MicroSD, including AVI (Motion-JPEG) recordings and MPEG-1 movies. Decoding happens in the browser: the device only streams the bytes.
dragHint: …or drag a video or audio file into this window
dragDrop: Drop a video or a track — or an .srt/.vtt file while playing
plSdError: MicroSD not mounted or folder unreadable.
plEmpty: No media files in this folder.
aboutDesc: Media player for NucleoOS. Decoding in the browser (including Motion-JPEG AVI and MPEG-1 via WebAssembly) and block-wise loading (HTTP Range) from the device MicroSD.
errNotFound: File not found on the MicroSD.
errNoFrames: Empty recording: the file contains no frames.
errNetwork: Network error while reading from the device. Try again shortly.
errCorrupt: The file is damaged or incomplete.
errDecode: Cannot decode the video: damaged file or unsupported format.
errUnsupportedCodec: Unsupported video codec ({codec}). Only Motion-JPEG is supported in AVI files.
errMpeg2: MPEG-2 video is not supported: convert it to MPEG-1 with the Nucleo Video Converter.
errNoVideo: The file has no video track.
errDecoderLoad: Cannot load the video decoder. Reload the page.
errNative: The browser cannot play this file (unsupported format or codec).
audioBlocked: Audio waiting: click or press a key to turn it on
audioUnsupported: {codec} audio is not supported: playing without sound
nfvOld: Old .nfv format (v{v}) is no longer supported: convert it again with Video Studio
